columns.name: Backlog
columns.instructions: Capture unscheduled work here. Keep enough context to decide whether it belongs in this workflow.

columns.name: Ready
columns.instructions: Only move work here when its required inputs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and approvals are ready.

columns.name: In Progress
columns.instructions: Execute the current workflow phase, update the checklist as work happens, and record blockers immediately.

columns.name: Review
columns.instructions: Require completed verification, reproducible evidence, and the workflow-specific review gate before acceptance.

columns.name: Done
columns.instructions: Only accept work whose criteria and required review are satisfied. Preserve the completion report and evidence.
